title: Orange International Street Fair
description: The premier annual Labor Day weekend celebration featuring 15 ethnic streets, world food delicacies, 8 live music stages, and local artisan craft booths surrounding The Circle.

title: Orange Home Grown Farmers & Artisans Market
description: Award-winning weekly community market featuring certified organic farmers, local artisan bakers, fresh coastal seafood, handcrafted ceramics, and live acoustic music.

title: Treats in the Streets Autumn Festival
description: Family-friendly Halloween community festival with costume parades, trick-or-treating at local historic merchants, community game booths, and autumn crafts.

title: Tree Lighting Ceremony & Candlelight Choir
description: Decades-old holiday tradition where hundreds gather around the historic 1937 Plaza Fountain for hot cider, carols by the local youth choir, and the lighting of the grand holiday pine.

title: Old Towne Antique & Flea Discovery Walk
description: Special monthly outdoor sidewalk showcase with vintage appraisal tables, vinyl record collectors, and specialty mid-century dealers setting up sidewalk exhibits along South Glassell.
